summary: Updates never stop a running pipeline, and identity reads are faster at large tenants.

fixes.title: Updates never cancel a running pipeline
fixes.text: An update now waits for a run to end and installs between two runs. An update never stops a running pipeline.

fixes.title: Private installs get more time to build
fixes.text: An update now waits up to 90 minutes for its build, since a private installation builds inside its own network.

fixes.title: Faster identity reads at large tenants
fixes.text: With the setting to skip inactive never-synced on-premises accounts on, those accounts are no longer read at all. The log says how many were skipped.
